2609.26990.title: Topological Signatures of Cyber-Attack Classes in Natural Visibility Graph Representations of Network Traffic
2609.26990.paper_summary: Natural Visibility Graph (NVG)-based representations provide a promising approach for capturing structural patterns in sequential network traffic. However, whether different cyber-attack classes exhibit distinctive topological signatures in such representations remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates the discriminative and structural characteristics of NVG-based network traffic representations using the CSE-CIC-IDS2018 dataset. Seventy-six numerical traffic features were independently transformed into NVGs within overlapping frames of 40 observations, and ten graph-theoretic metrics were extracted from each graph, resulting in 760 topological descriptors per frame. The discriminative capability of these representations was evaluated using a multi-branch convolutional neural network (CNN) with stratified five-fold cross-validation. The model achieved an average accuracy of 96.20% and a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.9566. To characterize class-specific topological differences, Kruskal-Wallis and Mann-Whitney U tests were combined with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction and effect-size measures. Of the 10,640 attack-versus-benign comparisons, 7,777 (73.1%) remained statistically significant after FDR correction, with 4,844 exhibiting large Cliff's delta effects. The strongest global differences were predominantly associated with backward-traffic and packet-length-related features combined with connectivity, clustering, and centrality measures. These findings indicate that NVG-derived representations can provide strong discriminative capability while revealing class-dependent topological patterns associated with different cyber-attack classes.
2609.26990.paper_summary_zh: 自然可見性圖（NVG）基礎的表示法提供了一種有前景的方法，用於捕捉序列網絡流量中的結構模式。<lb/>然而，不同的網絡攻擊類別在這些表示法中是否展現出獨特的拓撲特徵仍然不夠明瞭。<lb/>本研究使用CSE-CIC-IDS2018數據集探討了基於NVG的網絡流量表示法的區別性和結構特徵。<lb/>七十六個數值流量特徵在40個觀測值的重疊框架內獨立轉換為NVG，並從每個圖中提取了十個圖論度量，結果每個框架產生760個拓撲描述符。<lb/>這些表示法的區別能力使用多分支卷積神經網絡（CNN）進行了評估，並採用了分層五折交叉驗證。<lb/>該模型達到了96.20%的平均準確率和0.9566的馬修斯相關係數（MCC）。<lb/>為了表徵類別特定的拓撲差異，Kruskal-Wallis和Mann-Whitney U檢驗與Benjamini-Hochberg假發現率校正和效應大小測量相結合。<lb/>在10,640次攻擊與良性比較中，7,777次（73.1%）在FDR校正後仍然具有統計顯著性，其中4,844次顯示出較大的Cliff's delta效應。<lb/>最強的全球差異主要與反向流量和與包長相關的特徵結合連通性、聚類和中心性度量有關。<lb/>這些發現表明，基於NVG的表示法可以提供強大的區別能力，同時揭示與不同網絡攻擊類別相關的類別依賴性拓撲模式。
